CustomField.description: True once Embedding__c has been generated for this record's current content. Exists because Embedding__c is a Long Text Area and cannot be filtered in SOQL, so the SupportSolutionEmbedder backfill needs a queryable marker to find un-embedded rows. Set false (and optionally null Embedding__c) to force a re-embed.
CustomField.label: Embedding Synced
